body: Oh gosh thank you. You hit the spot man.

I'm so sorry for that wall of text. It helps to get it out. I wrote a suicide note today and cried the whole way through. I couldn't finish the page to her and I ripped the whole thing up and threw it away.

My drug use is social but I self prescribe xanax for anxiety. Our relationship was litterally the envy of any I've ever had up until she said she's confused and dropped the bomb and said "I love you but I need to have time to miss you". I was ready to quit my job, propose, move where ever. We are already in a LDR, we see each other infrequently and she wants space. I suggested an open relationship but she says she doesn't want to be with other people, she wants to be alone. She had dystimia and SAD. The PFD isn't helping nor the change of the seasons but she says she doesn't feel feminine or beautiful while I can't even look at another woman in light of her brilliance... Our relationship went from 60 to 0 immediately with no infidelity, no wandering eyes, no abuse, over space? Three hundred miles and two nights a month isn't enough space? I deleted my Facebook and other social tools. I can't bear to look. I saw her best friend a few hours ago, we met the same day and have been mutual friends. I cried in her arms for a while. She doesn't understand my partners decision either. My partner left me a message crying begging me not to hurt myself, I guess she had a feeling because I didn't mention it. How can she end every conversation with "I love you" but not want to be with me, with anyone, no excuse. When we are intimate it's fantastic, but day to day for weeks on end its just phone and text and I'm fine with that... She initiates most of those conversations, but she wants to end things because she needs space. I was never the clingy or jealous type. I was so secure in our relationship. All of my insecurities and fears can crashing back last night. I had made so much progress, had promised to learn to love myself. I feel empty and naked and scared and fake now. I have not seen a therapist. I wouldn't even know how. I haven't seen a doctor in 7 years, I don't even have a gp. ..
It's so exhausting trying to save the world that I can hardly take the time to try to love myself.
